title: Understanding Hyperspherical Geometry of ECAPA-TDNN Embedding and Its Impact on Zero-Shot Voice Conversion
abstract: arXiv:2609.24688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Angular-margin speaker encoders are widely used in voice conversion, yet the geometry of their classifier prototypes remains poorly understood. We analyze ECAPA-TDNN classifier prototypes as points on the unit hypersphere and characterize their organization using rotation-invariant angular statistics together with global and local effective dimensionality measures. Our analysis shows that standard training can induce angular concentration and a substantial reduction in effective dimensionality. To address this, we investigate two geometric regularization strategies (hinged Riesz log-energy and effective-dimension maximization) applied to classifier prototypes to encourage more uniform hyperspherical coverage. The resulting prototype sets exhibit higher effective dimensionality and improved isotropy, with configuration-dependent effects on speaker-recognition performance. translated_title: 理解ECAPA-TDNN嵌入的超球面几何及其对零样本语音转换的影响
translated_abstract: 角间隔说话人编码器被广泛应用于语音转换，然而其分类器原型的几何组织方式仍然缺乏深入理解。我们将ECAPA-TDNN分类器原型视为单位超球面上的点，并利用旋转不变的角统计量以及全局和局部有效维度度量来刻画其分布特性。我们的分析表明，标准训练会导致角聚集现象和有效维度的大幅降低。为解决这一问题，我们研究了两种几何正则化策略（带铰链的Riesz对数能量和有效维度最大化），将其应用于分类器原型，以促进更均匀的超球面覆盖。由此得到的原型集合表现出更高的有效维度和更好的各向同性，并对说话人识别性能产生依赖于具体配置的影响。当相应的ECAPA-TDNN模型被用作零样本语音转换中的说话人编码器时……
tldr: 该论文首次从超球面几何视角分析ECAPA-TDNN分类器原型，揭示标准训练会导致角聚集和有效维度下降，并提出两种几何正则化策略（hinged Riesz对数能量与有效维度最大化）以促进更均匀的超球面覆盖，从而改善零样本语音转换的说话人表征。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes ECAPA-TDNN classifier prototypes as points on the unit hypersphere, reveals that standard training induces angular concentration and reduced effective dimensionality, and proposes two geometric regularization strategies (hinged Riesz log-energy and effective-dimension maximization) to achieve more uniform hyperspherical coverage for improved zero-shot voice conversion.
